summary: Joseph Carlson After Hours makes the case that Google and Meta will outlast OpenAI and Anthropic in the AI race, published 2026-10-01. His argument: Gemini 4's frontier claims plus the incumbents' distribution, full-stack control and cash-flow funding give them staying power against rivals that must monetize aggressively to service their obligations. The video also includes a Netflix growth defense and a FICO post-mortem — he stayed out of FICO, with no forward call recorded there. All three of his recorded stances are unchanged holds: GOOGL — HOLD (prior HOLD 2026-09-28, no flip), described as his roughly $200k largest position, not selling. META — HOLD (prior HOLD 2026-09-28, no flip), fully invested with about $400k combined with GOOGL; he notes the free Muse tier is funded by Facebook/Instagram cash flows. NFLX — HOLD (prior HOLD 2026-09-28, no flip), which he considers the most undervalued name in his portfolio on his DCF, with territories up 10% and trailing returns up 16%. No flips and no new buys anywhere in this one.
